descripcion.es:
Day seven. One minute left. And one screen still on.

Fiction. Part 3.

#story #whatif #countdown

texto.es: Day six. You have not slept.
texto.en: Day six. You have not slept.

texto.es: You hide in an old cinema. The only building in the city with no screens.
texto.en: You hide in an old cinema. The only building in the city with no screens.

texto.es: Your phone shows one last message. Check the time.
texto.en: Your phone shows one last message. Check the time.

texto.es: Day seven. Three oh six a.m. One minute left.
texto.en: Day seven. Three oh six a.m. One minute left.

texto.es: Outside, every screen in the city goes black.
texto.en: Outside, every screen in the city goes black.

texto.es: Behind you, the cinema screen turns on.
texto.en: Behind you, the cinema screen turns on.

texto.es: On it, you see yourself. Sitting in the front row. Smiling.
texto.en: On it, you see yourself. Sitting in the front row. Smiling.

texto.es: And the you on the screen whispers one word.
texto.en: And the you on the screen whispers one word.
